full_text_zh:
[P1] 笑慧树
原创绘本
精选
成长的秘密
奇妙的生命
总主编/周兢
文图/马俐
华东师范大学出版社

[P2] 每个生命都是独一无二的。

[P3] 妈妈，我画了一颗蛋，猫宝宝
就要从蛋里面出来了。

[P4] 亲爱的，从这颗蛋
里面出来的肯定不会是
猫宝宝。

动物大致分为胎生和卵生。

从蛋里面孵化出来的是卵生，比如企鹅、
鸵鸟、乌龟还有蛇等很多动物都是卵生的。

[P5] 从妈妈肚子里生出来的动物都属于胎生，猫宝宝跟你一样都是从妈妈的肚子里生出来的。

[P6] 我是怎样来的呢，妈妈？
是爸爸和妈妈一起把你带来这个世界的。

[P7] 你是由爸爸的一颗精子和妈妈的一颗卵子结合而成的。

成千上万上亿的精子
里同时出发游进妈妈的身体，但只有一个
精子可以成为冠军与妈妈的卵子融合在一起成为
受精卵，那是最初的你。

你看，你是多么棒！

[P8] ① 受精卵不断分裂，然后植入妈妈的子宫内膜里。胚胎的外层细胞与妈妈的血管连接起来形成脐带、胎盘以及保护膜。而内层的细胞会发育成你的身体各部分。
② 第一个月，你的脑、脊柱和血管都在慢慢形成，手脚像种子的小芽一样开始发育，心脏也开始搏动。
③ 两个月，你的主要内脏器官都已经发育，面部已经可以辨认，并且自己会动了。
④ 三个月时，你的手指和脚趾已经形成。

[P9] ⑤ 四个月时，你有脖子了，手指上有了指纹。
⑥ 五个月时，你常常在妈妈肚子里踢腿。
⑦ 六个月时，你可以听见妈妈的声音，眼睛也可以看东西了。
⑧ 七个月时，你会呼吸和吞咽啦。

[P10] 妈妈常常感觉不舒服，就像生病了一样，这是因为随着你一天天长大，妈妈的内脏受到挤压。妈妈有时会消化不良，需要常常上厕所。
你肚子上那条脐带连接在妈妈的子宫内膜，你需要的所有食物和氧气都是由妈妈的血液经过脐带进入你体内的。你的排泄物也是经过脐带进入妈妈的血液，当妈妈上厕所时便将你的排泄物排出体外。

[P11] 八九个月时，你越来越大，比妈妈的肚子还要大，你活动的空间越来越小，随时都可能离开妈妈的身体。

[P12] 经过妈妈辛苦的十月怀胎，这一天终于来了。

[P13] 你离开妈妈的肚子来到这个世界，
变成独立的个体，连接你和妈妈的
脐带被剪断，渐渐干枯脱落后变
成现在的肚脐眼。

[P14] 出生后的最初几个月，
你对这个世界还不熟悉，不
习惯有白天和夜晚。常常
白天睡觉晚上吃奶。一家
人因为你的到来变得更忙
碌但也更快乐。

[P15] 你渐渐长大，爸爸妈妈的生活因为
你的成长而充满喜悦。

[P16] 有一天你会长成大人，也可能
像妈妈一样有自己的宝宝。

[P17] 有一天你也会变老，像爷爷奶奶外公外婆那么老。所有的生命都有出生、成长和衰老、结束的一天。

[P18] 就像花草树木和
所有的动物一样，我们人类的生命时光也
是有期限的。

[P19] 生活在这个地球上的所有生命都是独一无二的，
都有出生、成长和衰老、结束的一天。

每一个生命都曾经是宝宝，都同样来自爸爸
和妈妈，都值得珍惜。

[P20] 我们要和平
相处，互相爱护，
尊重其他生命。
full_text_en:
[P1] Xiaohui Tree
Original Picture Book
Selected
Secrets of Growth
The Wonderful Life
General Editor / Zhou Jing
Text and Illustrations / Ma Li
East China Normal University Press

[P2] Every life is unique.

[P3] Mom, I drew an egg, and the kitten
is going to come out of it.

[P4] Dear, what comes out of this egg
surely won't be a kitten.

Animals are generally divided into viviparous and oviparous.

Animals that hatch from eggs are oviparous, such as penguins,
ostriches, turtles, and snakes—many animals are oviparous.

[P5] Animals born from their mother's womb are called viviparous. Just like you, kittens are also born from their mother's womb.

[P6] How did I come to be, Mom?
Dad and Mom brought you into this world together.

[P7] You were formed by the union of one sperm from your dad and one egg from your mom.

Millions upon millions of sperm
set off at the same time to swim into your mom's body, but only one
sperm can become the champion and fuse with your mom's egg to become
a fertilized egg—that's your very first beginning.

Look, how amazing you are!

[P8] ① The fertilized egg keeps dividing and then implants into the lining of your mother's uterus. The outer layer of embryonic cells connects with the mother's blood vessels to form the umbilical cord, placenta, and protective membranes. The inner layer of cells will develop into all parts of your body.
② In the first month, your brain, spine, and blood vessels are gradually forming. Your hands and feet, like tiny sprouts, begin to develop, and your heart starts beating.
③ By two months, your main internal organs have developed, your face is recognizable, and you can move on your own.
④ By three months, your fingers and toes have formed.

[P9] ⑤ At four months, you have a neck, and fingerprints appear on your fingers.
⑥ At five months, you often kick inside your mom's tummy.
⑦ At six months, you can hear your mom's voice, and your eyes can also see things.
⑧ At seven months, you can breathe and swallow.

[P10] Mom often feels uncomfortable, as if she's sick, because as you grow day by day, Mom's internal organs are being pressed. Mom sometimes has indigestion and needs to go to the bathroom frequently.
That umbilical cord on your belly is connected to Mom's uterine lining. All the food and oxygen you need enter your body through the umbilical cord via Mom's blood. Your waste products also enter Mom's bloodstream through the umbilical cord, and when Mom goes to the bathroom, your waste is expelled from her body.

[P11] When you are eight or nine months old, you grow bigger and bigger, even bigger than Mommy's belly. The space for you to move becomes smaller and smaller, and you might leave Mommy's body at any time.

[P12] After ten months of hard pregnancy, this day has finally come.

[P13] You leave your mom's belly and come into this world,
becoming an independent individual. The umbilical cord that connected you and your mom is cut, and after gradually drying up and falling off, it becomes your belly button now.

[P14] In the first few months after birth,
You are still unfamiliar with this world, not
used to having days and nights. You often
sleep during the day and feed at night. The whole
family becomes busier but also happier because of your arrival.

[P15] You are growing up, and your parents' life is filled with joy because of your growth.

[P16] One day you will grow up to be an adult, and maybe
have your own baby just like Mommy.

[P17] One day, you will also grow old, as old as grandpa, grandma, grandfather, and grandmother. All lives have a beginning, growth, aging, and an end.

[P18] Just like flowers, grass, trees, and all animals, the span of human life is also limited.

[P19] All lives on this Earth are unique,
and each has a day of birth, growth, aging, and ending.

Every life was once a baby, all coming from dad
and mom, and all are worth cherishing.

[P20] We should live in peace,
look after each other,
and respect other lives.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《奇妙的生命》的封面，展示了书名、作者信息及一个婴儿爬行与小猫互动的插图。
[P2] 本页展示了四个姿态和表情各异的婴儿，并配文强调每个生命都是独一无二的。
[P3] 一个小女孩正在画画，她画了一颗蛋，说猫宝宝就要从蛋里出来了，旁边有一只猫在看着她的画。
[P4] 一位女性和一个小女孩正在一起画画，画中是一只从蛋里孵出的小鸟。旁边有一只猫在观察。页面文字解释了动物分为胎生和卵生，并举例说明卵生动物如企鹅、鸵鸟、乌龟和蛇。
[P5] 本页通过文字和插图解释了胎生动物的概念，指出猫、人类以及图中的袋鼠、大象、北极熊等都是从妈妈肚子里生出来的，并配有一名小女孩抱着小猫的画面。
[P6] 画面左侧，爸爸亲吻妈妈的脸颊；右侧，妈妈抱着女儿荡秋千。文字呈现了孩子对生命来源的提问以及父母的温柔回答。
[P7] 本页通过插图和文字解释了生命的起源，说明孩子是由爸爸的精子和妈妈的卵子结合形成的，并强调在众多精子中只有一个能成功受精，形成最初的受精卵。
[P8] 本页通过四幅插图和对应文字，展示了人类胚胎从受精卵到三个月大时的发育过程，包括植入子宫、器官形成、心脏搏动、面部可辨认及手脚形成等关键阶段。
[P9] 本页通过四幅插图和文字，展示了人类胚胎从四个月到七个月的发育过程，包括脖子和指纹的形成、在子宫内踢腿、能听见声音和看东西、以及学会呼吸和吞咽等关键发育阶段。
[P10] 本页通过插图和文字解释了孕妇在怀孕期间因胎儿成长而产生的身体不适，如内脏受压、消化不良和频繁上厕所，并说明了胎儿通过脐带与母体进行营养和废物交换的过程。
[P11] 本页通过孕妇抚摸肚子的插图和胎儿在子宫内蜷缩的剖面图，说明胎儿在怀孕八九个月时体型增大，活动空间变小，随时可能出生。
[P12] 本页通过三幅胎儿在子宫内蜷缩的剖面图，配合文字说明，描绘了怀孕末期胎儿发育成熟、即将出生的时刻。
[P13] 本页描绘了新生儿出生的瞬间，母亲躺在产床上，医护人员剪断脐带，文字解释了脐带被剪断后干枯脱落形成肚脐眼的过程。
[P14] 本页描绘了新生儿出生后最初几个月的生活状态，文字说明婴儿不熟悉昼夜规律，常白天睡觉晚上吃奶，家人因宝宝的到来而忙碌但更快乐。画面中祖父母抱着新生儿，表情慈爱。
[P15] 画面描绘了一位母亲推着婴儿车在开满粉色花朵的小路上散步，文字说明孩子逐渐长大，父母的生活因孩子的成长而充满喜悦。
[P16] 画面描绘了一位母亲牵着幼儿的手在花丛边散步，文字表达了孩子未来会长大并可能成为父母的期许。
[P17] 本页通过一位年轻人推着轮椅上老人的画面，配合文字说明生命终将衰老和结束，呼应了生命循环的主题。
[P18] 画面描绘了一位老人牵着小女孩的手在树林中散步，文字说明人类生命如同花草树木和动物一样，是有期限的，呼应了生命循环的主题。
[P19] 本页通过描绘池塘中盛开的莲花、游动的鱼、青蛙和乌龟，以及远处一家三口散步的温馨画面，配合文字说明生命皆独一无二且有始有终，强调每个生命都值得珍惜，呼应生命循环的主题。
[P20] 画面描绘了四个穿着黄色运动服的孩子站在一起，其中一人敬礼，另一人手持帽子，旁边有蒲公英和小花，文字强调和平相处、互相爱护和尊重生命。
